order_mode: independent seeded shuffle per repeat; seed offset per allocation
allocation_rule: three allocations on disjoint node sets, so every input is timed on three distinct GPUs

claim_rules.shape: winner beats comparator by more than 5% in every allocation (three distinct GPUs), separately for re-measured F128/F512, held-out F256 (primary: F512-selected pair) and held-out 1M
claim_rules.cusparse: BOO winner against the fastest same-cell direct algorithm, full-call scope: original-order direct_<alg>_api; reordered steady_api (resident X', Y'); reordered gather_api (original coordinates). A win needs the minimum over allocations above 1.05; 0.95-1.05 is parity
claim_rules.sensitivity: every comparison reported with and without the post-hoc control-band filter
